title: Roman numerals
hints: Keep the table as a list of {value, symbol} tuples, largest first, including the subtractive pairs such as {900, "CM"}.
to_roman: if n is at least the first value in the list, emit its symbol and recurse with n - value and the SAME list. Otherwise drop the first entry and recurse.
from_roman: with the same table, if the text starts with the first symbol, add its value and remove that prefix. Otherwise move on to the next entry.
